title: Data Center Engineer
description:
**About Sycomp**

Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider, delivering complex technology solutions to enterprise customers worldwide. Headquartered in Silicon Valley, we support clients across more than 150 countries through our global integration centers, logistics networks, and engineering expertise.

Our teams operate at the intersection of IT infrastructure, supply chain, and services, enabling organizations to deploy and manage technology seamlessly across global environments. We are recognized for solving complex challenges and delivering reliable, scalable solutions that support critical operations.

At Sycomp, you will be part of a collaborative, globally distributed team where ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement are embedded in everything we do.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly skilled and self-driven Data Center Engineer to join our Mumbai team, supporting critical infrastructure deployments for global enterprise customers. This is a hands-on, field-focused role where you will play a key part in delivering complex data center projects end-to-end, from initial rack integration through to full system commissioning and customer handover.

This position is ideal for engineers who thrive in dynamic, project-based environments and enjoy being on the ground delivering tangible outcomes. You will take ownership of installations, troubleshooting, and validation activities, ensuring that deployments meet both technical design standards and customer expectations. In addition to core delivery, you will contribute to maintaining high operational standards, documentation accuracy, and quality control across projects.

At Sycomp, this role offers the opportunity to work on diverse, real-world deployment scenarios across different sites, gaining exposure to evolving data center technologies and best practices. You will be part of a collaborative global delivery network where initiative, technical depth, and execution excellence are highly valued. With flexible working hours aligned to project needs and opportunities to support multi-site engagements, the role provides both stability and variety.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end rack deployment, including mounting, bolt-down, structured cabling (fiber and copper), power integration, and labeling.
* Execute installation, configuration, and commissioning of servers, routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless infrastructure across OEMs such as Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Arista, HPE, and Dell.
* Coordinate with customers, OEM engineers, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution and acceptance testing.
* Perform fiber and copper termination, patching, OTDR testing, and performance validation to ensure network reliability.
* Validate LAN/WAN connectivity, redundancy, failover, and security configurations in line with the approved design.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis during deployment and maintenance phases.
* Maintain detailed documentation, including as-built diagrams, rack elevations, and test reports.
* Ensure all activities comply with safety, ESD, and data center operational standards.
* Support and mentor field engineers to maintain installation quality and standards.

**Requirements**

* Strong hands-on experience in data center infrastructure deployment, rack integration, and field implementation.
* Deep understanding of data center architecture, structured cabling systems, and hardware components.
* Experience working in multi-vendor environments and with network infrastructure protocols.
* Strong stakeholder management and on-site coordination skills.
* A hands-on, results-driven mindset with a focus on operational excellence.
* CCNA certification required; additional global certifications preferred.
* Willingness to travel for multi-site deployment projects, approximately 10% as business needs require.

**Why Join Sycomp?**

**Technology Means the World to Us**

Technology connects people, enables business, fosters innovation, and helps organizations operate without boundaries. Every day, Sycomp’s diverse team delivers on the company’s mission to help customers and partners navigate the complexity of global IT, from cloud and data center computing to cybersecurity, networking, integration, and logistics across more than 150 countries.

If you thrive in a growth-minded and values-driven culture, Sycomp may be your next career adventure. You will have the opportunity to work in a global setting, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and be part of a dynamic and growing organization. Sycomp is known for its strong culture and commitment to employee growth. With a 93% company-wide retention rate, we foster an environment where people can make a meaningful impact, develop professionally, and build rewarding careers over the long term.

**Learn more about Sycomp and our employee benefits at:**
https://sycomp.com/careers/

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

*Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*

*Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at careers@sycomp.com.*

title: Delivery Consultant - Databases, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Are you an experienced Oracle/SQL Server Platform Specialist? Have you worked on Open source Database platforms like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Cassandra? Have you migrated Applications from one Database Engine to another? Do you like to engage with senior leadership and determine ways to optimize the IT Platforms & Infrastructure? Do you like to solve the most complex and high scale data challenges in the world today? Do you want to have an impact in the development and use of new platform technologies? Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help organizations understand and use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster, at lower cost?
  
  
You will collaborate with our internal customers and partners in AWS ProServe India LLP on key engagements for internal customers and will assist in developing and delivering proof-of-concept projects, technical workshops, and support implementation projects in order to migrate Applications from Oracle/SQL Server databases to Aurora-PostgreSQL/MySQL or other Open Source platforms using latest GenAI tooling available
  
  
Our professional services engagements will focus on internal customer’s solutions such as high volume OLTP/OLAP environments, batch data processing, designing and deploying future state petabyte-scale data warehouse service and building and/or designing reference configurations to enable our customers and influence AWS RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Redshift adoption.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  
Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  
  
Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  
  
Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
  
  
Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Knowledge of the primary aws services (ec2, elb, rds, route53 & s3)
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience in Postgres, or experience in software development and experience in SQL Server/MySQL
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of database administration experience, or Bachelor's degree in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
* Experience with the AWS platform, web services, software development, or related technologie
* AWS Professional level certification, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience scripting for automation (e.g., Python, Perl, Ruby)
* Knowledge of security and compliance standards including HIPAA and GDPR
* Experience in Database like NoSQL, or experience in any Bigdata architecture and experience in Hive/Spark/Hbase/Yarn
* Experience with massively parallel processing (MPP) databases - Redshift, Teradata etc.

title: IT Operations Lead
description:
**ABOUT US** 




 BDx Data Centers is an AI\-ready digital infrastructure platform operating across Asia\-Pacific, with data centers in Singapore, Indonesia, Hong Kong, and Taiwan, and new markets in development. We deliver the powered, cooled, and connected capacity customers need to scale AI, cloud, hyperscale, and enterprise workloads across the region.
 



  





 Our platform brings together secured power access, high\-density design, advanced cooling capabilities, interconnection, and local market execution to accelerate delivery from grid connection to live workload. With 1\.2GVA\+ of secured grid capacity and a platform spanning campuses, hyperscale facilities, colocation, and edge infrastructure, BDx is built to support the next generation of digital growth.
 



  





 Backed by I Squared Capital, BDx is transformed for AI and proven at speed.
 



  





 For more information, visit www.bdxworld.com
 



  





  





**Role Summary** 




 The Senior IT Operations Lead will provide technical leadership and operational ownership of the organization's internal IT infrastructure and OT technology environment supporting Data Center operations. This is a senior hands\-on individual contributor role within a captive Data Center organization, responsible for the reliability, security, availability, governance, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of the organization's own technology environment.
 



  





**Duties \& Responsibilities** 




**1\. IT Infrastructure Operations \& Reliability** 




 • Provide technical and operational leadership for the organization's enterprise IT infrastructure supporting corporate and Data Center operations.
 



 • Ensure the availability, reliability, performance, and security of infrastructure operating on a 24x7x365 basis.
 



 • Oversee networking, servers and compute, virtualization, storage, backup, firewalls, security infrastructure, wireless, telephony, collaboration systems, end\-user computing, and monitoring platforms.
 



 • Drive proactive monitoring, capacity planning, performance optimization, technology lifecycle management, and operational KPI tracking.
 



**2\. OT Security \& Data Center Technology Environment** 




 • Support and govern IT and OT security procedures relevant to Data Center operations.
 



 • Work closely with Data Center Operations, Engineering, Security, Automation, and Technology teams to ensure appropriate protection and segregation of IT and OT environments.
 



 • Develop and maintain procedures for secure access, privileged access, remote connectivity, patching, vulnerability management, and system hardening.
 



 • Support security assessments, audits, vulnerability remediation, risk mitigation, incident response, and root cause analysis involving IT and OT\-related systems.
 



**3\. IT Service Management \& Operational Governance** 




 • Lead and continuously improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Configuration, and Asset Management processes.
 



 • Analyse recurring incidents and operational trends and implement preventive and corrective actions.
 



 • Drive service reviews, KPI reporting, risk tracking, root cause analysis, and continual service improvement.
 



**4\. Infrastructure Architecture \& Technology Lifecycle** 




 • Participate in infrastructure reviews and assess the impact of new systems, technology changes, and infrastructure enhancements.
 



 • Provide recommendations for scalability, resilience, security, operational supportability, and risk mitigation.
 



 • Support infrastructure modernization including cloud, hybrid infrastructure, software\-defined networking, automation, and Infrastructure\-as\-a\-Service models.
 



**5\. SDLC, Change \& Release Governance** 




 • Demonstrate strong awareness of SDLC and its impact on infrastructure and production environments.
 



 • Work with application, automation, engineering, and technology teams to ensure infrastructure readiness for development, testing, deployment, and production releases.
 



 • Ensure appropriate testing, documentation, rollback plans, approvals, risk assessments, and operational readiness before production implementation.
 



**6\. Information Security, Compliance \& Documentation** 




 • Support compliance with ISO 27001 and ISO 20000 requirements and maintain relevant operational documentation and evidence.
 



 • Maintain infrastructure standards, procedures, architecture diagrams, Configuration Items (CIs), CMDB records, and IT asset documentation.
 



 • Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings and compliance actions.
 



**7\. Security, Monitoring \& Critical Incident Management** 




 • Provide technical oversight for routers, switches, Layer 2/3 networks, firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, and connectivity infrastructure.
 



 • Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, operational visibility, and proactive issue detection.
 



 • Lead technical investigations for major incidents, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.
 



**8\. Vendor \& Internal Stakeholder Management** 




 • Manage technical relationships and escalations with infrastructure, security, telecommunications, and technology vendors.
 



 • Partner with internal Data Center Operations, Engineering, Information Security, Automation, Applications, Corporate IT, Facilities, and business stakeholders.
 



 • Communicate technical risks, operational performance, improvement initiatives, and infrastructure status to senior stakeholders.
 



**9\. Individual Contributor Technical Leadership** 




 • Act as a senior technical owner and subject matter expert, leading through technical expertise, governance, influence, and operational ownership.
 



 • Work independently on complex technical and operational issues and mentor engineers where required.
 



 • This is primarily a hands\-on senior individual contributor role and is not intended to be a traditional service delivery, customer account management, or managed services role.
 



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 




 15\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, infrastructure operations, or IT operations leadership.
 



 • Experience supporting business\-critical, highly available, 24x7x365 infrastructure environments.
 



 • Strong experience operating internal enterprise or captive technology environments; experience should not be limited to external customer managed services delivery.
 



 • Strong technical experience across enterprise networking, Layer 2/3 infrastructure, routers, switches, firewalls, WAN, VPN, Wi\-Fi, servers, virtualization, monitoring, infrastructure security, backup, and configuration management.
 



 • Strong experience in Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Root Cause Analysis, KPI reporting, trend analysis, and continual service improvement.
 



 • Practical understanding of IT and OT security principles, access management, vulnerability remediation, patching, infrastructure hardening, and operational security procedures.
 



 • Strong awareness of SDLC, production change governance, release management, testing, risk assessment, rollback planning, and operational readiness.
 



 • Experience with monitoring platforms such as Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds, Cacti, or similar tools.
 



 • Experience conducting infrastructure architecture reviews and developing mitigation plans for technical and operational risks.
 



 • Strong vendor management, stakeholder management, analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, written, and verbal communication skills.
 



**Good\-to\-Have Skills** 




 • Experience working in a Data Center operator or other mission\-critical infrastructure environment.
 



 • Exposure to OT environments supporting critical infrastructure, including Data Center automation, BMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar operational technologies.
 



 • Knowledge of OT/ICS security principles and industrial cybersecurity practices.
 



 • Experience with public cloud, hybrid cloud, software\-defined networking, infrastructure automation, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, or DevSecOps practices.
 



 • Experience with Zero Trust, SIEM, SOC, EDR, vulnerability management, or security monitoring platforms.
 



 • Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning.
 



**Preferred Certifications** 




 • CCNP or equivalent Cisco certification.
 



 • CISSP, CISM, or equivalent information security certification.
 



 • ITIL certification.
 



 • Microsoft infrastructure, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), OT/ICS security, or Six Sigma/process improvement certifications.
 



  





**At BDx, we believe that our success lies in the hands of our talented and dedicated employees. Together, we are shaping the future of the data center industry and making a positive impact on the world.**

 Job Description:
   

  

 As a production support engineer, you will be involved in the day to day activities associated with supporting of the MarkitEDM production and UAT application and User Interface. You will ensure successful end to end processing of daily regional feeds, resolving workflow issues, reloading historical file requests, break/fix changes and small enhancements, and troubleshooting issues raised by downstream consumers of MarkitEDM data.
   

  

 The purpose of this MarkitEDM production support engineer is to provide frontline technical support of the MarkitEDM application and User Interface to our MarkitEDM project development team, data operations team, and downstream internal consumers of MarkitEDM data. You liaison with MarkitEDM project developers in London and Seattle and troubleshoot issue with other business critical applications across the Russell Investment landscape.
   

  

 The ideal candidate for this role will be someone with strong customer service skills, a team player who can also work independently, and adheres to application and company best practices. A combination of strengths, both technical and soft skills, is a must to be successful in this highly demanding role.
   

  

**Years Of Experience**
* Minimum 1 \- 3 years MarkitEDM experience
* Experience with Tidal scheduler tool a plus
* 1 \- 3 years of experience in the financial industry preferred


**Qualifications**
* MarkitEDM experience either developing or supporting the platform
* Knowledge of data warehousing and management of large volumes of data
* Strong Microsoft SQL skills including updates, deletes, and joins
* Ability to communicate technical details to all levels of management, both written and verbal
* Experience troubleshooting and resolving complex issue in a timely manner
* Effective at working under pressure in a high paced environment


**Special Requirements**
* Occasional calls/meetings with Seattle and/or London outside of normal work hours
* Occasional weekend and on call shifts (up to twice monthly)


**Responsibilities**
* Supporting the technology associated with the MarkitEDM application – including interactions with the Investment Division as well as other internal application consumers to provide reliable, scalable, and timely support of the production and UAT environments.
* Providing change management oversight of the application as well as other dependent application changes.
* Ensuring all changes and processes are properly documented.
* Ensuring internal data integrity which includes regional securities, positions, and pricing data loads. Also providing timely support of issues regarding long running processes, troubleshooting timeout issues with downstream consumers, and investigating data issues internally and/or with data operations.
* Investigating and resolving break fix issues, which may include minor development work, as well as ensure proper build and deployment of changes to lower environments in conjunction with company SDLC standards.
* Escalate troubleshooting assistance to the MarkitEDM vendor, when necessary.
* Coordinate and execute upgrades of the MarkitEDM platform as well as server and database upgrades/migrations.
* Coordinating technology efforts with Corporate IT and the business units.
* Providing support to business units in troubleshooting data issues and reaching resolution.


**Core Values**
* Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication and collaboration skills with all levels of management
* Strong organizational skills including the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and meet frequent deadlines,
* Demonstrated proactive approach to problem\-solving with strong judgment and decision\-making capability.
* Highly resourceful and collaborative team\-player, with the ability to also be independently effective and exude initiative and a sense of urgency.
* Exemplifies our customer\-focused, action\-oriented, results\-driven culture.
* Forward looking thinker, who actively seeks opportunities, has a desire for continuous learning, and proposes solutions.
* Ability to act with discretion and maintain complete confidentiality.
* Dedicated to the firm’s values of non\-negotiable integrity, valuing our people, exceeding client expectations, and embracing intellectual curiosity and rigor.

 Full Time

1. **ROLE**



  




* The Change Coordinator is responsible for managing and overseeing all customer\-related changes within the GOC team, with a primary focus on code upgrades and adherence to internal change management processes.
* This role ensures that all change activities are planned, documented, reviewed, and coordinated in compliance with both customer governance standards, customer availability and NTTGN internal change policies, NOCCP101\.
* The Change Coordinator serves as the central point of contact for change control, code upgrade scheduling, Vendor maintenance, GOC\-initiated Maintenance, and CAB participation, ensuring operational consistency and risk mitigation across all assigned customer accounts.
* Change Coordinators must be capable of efficiently planning and executing a high volume of upgrade activities.



  




1. **RESPONSIBILITIES**



  





**1\. Change Coordination \& Governance** 



* Coordinate all customer change requests, maintenance and ensure alignment with internal and customer\-specific change management frameworks.
* Plan, track, and oversee all change, maintenance activities across managed environment ensuring minimal disruption to the service which includes working with the Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and change owners to document the impact assessments for all proposed changes ensuring clarity and completeness
* Represent NTTGN during Customer Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings to present planned changes, maintenances and gain CAB approvals.
* Maintain complete and accurate documentation for all change activities, maintenances within the NTTGN ticketing system (Siebel) \& customer ticketing system (Service\-Now, Remedy etc.).








**2\. Code Upgrade Ownership** 



* Own the end\-to\-end coordination of customer code upgrades including planning, scheduling, coordination, validation, post\-upgrade review and status update.

* Ensure that upgrade activities align with customer maintenance windows and service continuity standards.

**3\. Ticket Queue Management** 



* Monitor and manage the change ticket, maintenance queues to ensure SLAs are met.

* Review open change, maintenance tickets for accuracy, completeness, and timely progress updates.
* Follow\-up with customer on incident/event tickets in “customer time” upon Manager’s direction
* Escalate risks or delays to appropriate stakeholders to maintain compliance with service targets.



  





**4\. Process Compliance \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Enforce compliance with NTTGN internal change control processes NOCCP101 across all technical teams.
* Perform quality checks on sharepoint information, NTTView reporting, device status in NTTGN tools, peer\-reviews etc.
* Support internal audits by maintaining accurate change and upgrading documentation.



  





**5\. Communication \& Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Serve as the liaison between internal teams, service delivery managers, project managers and customer contacts regarding change activities.
* Provide clear communication on change schedules, approvals, and risks to both internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure awareness and readiness for all planned changes.

* Bachelors in engineering \- Computers/Electronics/Communication or related field

title: L2 Support Specialist, MediaOps
description:
**About Adapt** 




**Adapt operates cloud\-based infrastructure and workstations used by production and post\-production teams. This role is the first line of support for those users: you keep people working, you document what you find, and you escalate with enough context that the next technician can act.** 




  





**About the role** 




**The L2 Support Specialist is the first point of contact for MediaOps support. You will field tickets, troubleshoot Windows and macOS issues, administer Microsoft 365 user accounts for onboarding and offboarding, and follow runbooks so routine work is handled consistently.** 




  





**This is an L2 role. The right person can grow into L3 over time by building depth in our operations environment, ticket quality, and judgment about when to resolve versus escalate.** 




  





**What you will do** 



* Own the L2 queue: triage, document, and resolve incoming support tickets for MediaOps workstations and related user issues.
* **Troubleshoot Windows and macOS problems, including connectivity, local client setup, login, performance, and common application issues.**
* **Walk users through first\-line checks, capture reproduction steps and evidence, and keep ticket notes accurate enough for a clean handoff.**
* **Administer Microsoft 365 user accounts, including account creation and disablement, license assignment, mailbox basics, group access, and standard onboarding and offboarding checklists.**
* **Escalate in scope: identify issues that belong withL3, Cloud Engineering, or another owner; include what was tried, impact, and supporting detail; follow the ticket until the user is unblocked.**
* **Communicate clearly with editors, engineers, and other MediaOps users, including people who are not technical.**
* **Follow documented runbooks and suggest practical updates when you find gaps or repeating patterns.**



**﻿**




**Required qualifications** 



* 3–5 years in help desk, desktop support, or L1/L2 IT support. Experience in a media, creative, or production environment is a plus.
* **Solid working knowledge of Windows (10/11\), including user profiles, networking basics, and common desktop troubleshooting.**
* **Working knowledge of macOS, including user accounts, network settings, permissions, and typical client or application issues.**
* **Experience with a ticketing system (osTicket, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, ServiceNow, or similar).**
* **Microsoft 365 administration basics: user lifecycle, licenses, groups, and mailbox administration.**
* **Clear written and verbal English; able to write ticket notes another technician can act on.**
* **Judgment to stay in L1 scope and escalate rather than guess at backend or security\-sensitive changes.**
* **Ability to work India Standard Time hours in support of MediaOps users in that coverage window.**



**Nice to have** 



* Some AWS familiarity (console basics, regions, instance state). You will not be expected to design or own cloud infrastructure.
* **Experience supporting remote or cloud workstations (Amazon DCV or similar).**
* **Exposure to media workflows or creative applications (Pro Tools, Adobe Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, or similar).**
* **Experience with high\-bandwidth remote sessions or cloud media storage tools.**



**How we will measure success** 




**First 90 days** 



* Handle routine MediaOps workstation tickets and Microsoft 365 onboarding/offboarding with little rework.
* **Keep tickets complete: correct priority, clear notes, and timely user updates.**
* **Escalate with context: what was tried, evidence, and who is blocked.**



**Growth path** 



* Over time, take on more complex workstation issues, improve runbooks, and expand toward L3 responsibilities if performance and interest support it.



  




* **Adapt is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation, employment type, and pre\-employment requirements will be confirmed by HR.**

title: Senior Engineer - Product Support

We help organisations run high\-velocity sales through intelligent automation, enabling teams to close more, faster. Backed by Stakeboat Capital and Gaja Capital, our 1,300\+ strong team spans India, the US, Middle East, ASEAN, ANZ, and South Africa.
   

  

 BFSI — banks, NBFCs, housing finance companies, insurers, and digital lenders — is one of LeadSquared's largest and most mission\-critical verticals, powering digital lending and insurance sales journeys where uptime, accuracy, and compliance directly affect our customers' business.

**02 🎯 The Opportunity**
 Product Support at LeadSquared is not a call centre. It is a critical, high\-impact role that sits at the intersection of technology, customer relationships, and product improvement — and within the BFSI vertical, it also sits at the intersection of compliance and business continuity. You are the expert BFSI customers turn to when a disbursement is stuck, a policy workflow breaks, or an integration with a bureau or KYC provider fails — and your ability to solve, communicate, and empathise directly shapes their experience with LeadSquared.
   

  

*We are looking for people who love making customers successful — who feel the customer's pain, own the problem, and don't rest until it's resolved, especially when a fix carries real business and regulatory stakes for a bank, NBFC, or insurer.*
**03 ⚙️ What You'll Do**
* Take full ownership of customer issues — from the first touchpoint to complete resolution
* Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues across the LeadSquared platform with speed and precision, including issues within loan/policy origination workflows and disbursement or renewal pipelines
* Ask sharp, targeted questions to get to the root cause — fast, including tracing failures across bureau checks, eKYC/eSign steps, and other BFSI\-specific integrations
* Guide customers through solutions via phone, email, and chat with patience and clarity — often engaging credit, risk, operations, or compliance teams on the customer side
* Deliver resolution within SLA timelines — every time, without exception — with heightened urgency around issues that block disbursements, collections, or regulatory reporting deadlines
* Work closely with engineering and product teams to surface bugs, patterns, and improvement opportunities specific to BFSI workflows and integrations
* Manage and exceed customer expectations — turn every support interaction into a trust\-building moment with compliance\-conscious BFSI stakeholders
* Contribute to the knowledge base — write clear technical articles, scripts, and diagnostic guides, including BFSI\-specific troubleshooting playbooks
* Support customer onboarding — deliver product training (web and in\-person) for admins and end users at banks, NBFCs, and insurance companies


**04 ✅ Must Have**
* 1 to 3 years of experience in product/technical support for a web\-based SaaS platform
* Strong troubleshooting ability — you can diagnose complex issues systematically and efficiently
* Solid understanding of APIs, Webhooks, and Connectors
* Excellent written and verbal communication — clear, empathetic, and professional, including when navigating compliance\-sensitive conversations
* Experience working with North American and/or Indian enterprise customers; experience with BFSI (banking, NBFC, insurance, or fintech lending) customers is a strong plus
* Ability to work in a 24/7 shift environment


**Good to Have**
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language — PHP, Java, or Python
* Experience with CRM or marketing automation platforms
* Exposure to core banking systems, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), or Loan Management Systems (LMS) — e.g., FinnOne, Newgen, Lentra, or similar
* Familiarity with BFSI\-specific integrations — credit bureau checks (CIBIL/Experian/CRIF), eKYC/Aadhaar\-based verification, DigiLocker, or eSign
* Basic awareness of RBI/IRDAI regulatory guidelines relevant to digital lending or insurance distribution
* Ability to create proof\-of\-concept solutions, sample scripts, and diagnostic tools


**05 📊 Key Metrics You'll Own**
 ⏱️
   

  

**First Response Time**
 Speed matters — always
   

  

 🎯
   

  

**SLA Adherence**
 Zero misses, every ticket
   

  

 😊
   

  

**CSAT Score**
 Delight, don't just resolve
   

  

 📚
   

  

**KB Contribution**
 Share knowledge, scale impact
   

  

 🔁
   

  

**Escalation Rate**
 Solve more, escalate less
   

  

 06 💙 How You'll Embody Our Values
   

  

 At LeadSquared, this role is not just a function — it's a reflection of who we are as a company. Here's how your work ties to our core values:
   

  

**◆ Customer Obsession**
 Every ticket, every call, every chat — the customer comes first, whether it's a bank, an NBFC, or an insurer.
   

  

**◆ Empathy**
 You feel the frustration of a stuck disbursement or blocked policy issuance. You own the fix. You follow through.
   

  

**◆ Ownership**
 No escalation until you've exhausted every option. You own it.
   

  

**◆ Integrity**
 You set realistic expectations and always deliver on your word — critical when compliance deadlines are on the line.
   

  

**◆ Innovation**
 You don't just fix — you find smarter ways to prevent issues across BFSI\-specific workflows.
   

  

**◆ Collaboration**
 You are the bridge between BFSI customers and the product team.
   

  

**07 🚀 Why LeadSquared**
**⚡ Fast\-Paced Growth**
 Work in an environment where impact is visible and rewarded quickly
   

  

**🧠 Best Minds**
 Collaborate with industry leaders and product innovators
   

  

**📈 Accelerated Career**
 Performance\-driven growth — your trajectory is in your hands
   

  

**🤝 Open Leadership**
 Easily approachable management — ideas are heard and acted on
   

  

**🏦 BFSI Leadership**
 Work at the centre of one of the fastest\-growing BFSI CRM and lending automation practices in the market
   

  

**⏰ Flexible Environment**
 A culture that trusts its people to deliver on their own terms
   

  

*If you believe great support in BFSI is not about closing tickets — it's about earning the trust of a bank, an NBFC, or an insurer when it matters most — we want you on this team.*

**Job Description: Qualys L2 Engineer / Consultant** 




**Experience:** 
**3–6 years of relevant cybersecurity or vulnerability management experience** 
 , including hands\-on Qualys administration and client\-facing support.
 



  





**Role overview** 




 We are looking for a Qualys L2 Engineer / Consultant to support vulnerability management operations for clients in India and across global regions. The role requires hands\-on Qualys expertise, strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, and the ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical teams and client stakeholders.
 



**Key responsibilities** 



* Administer and support Qualys vulnerability \& Configuration management activities across client environments.
* Configure and manage asset discovery, scan schedules, scanner appliances, authentication settings, tags, and dashboards.
* Review scan results, investigate scan failures and authentication issues, and resolve coverage gaps.
* Validate and prioritize vulnerabilities using severity, asset criticality, exposure, and available remediation information.
* Work with infrastructure, cloud, application, and security teams to track remediation and verify fixes through rescanning.
* Investigate false positives and document the rationale for findings, exceptions, and risk acceptance requests.
* Prepare vulnerability reports, operational dashboards, and concise summaries for technical and management audiences.
* Handle L2 support tickets and client escalations within agreed service levels; engage the OEM or internal specialists when needed.
* Lead or participate in client calls, explain findings and remediation recommendations, and provide clear status updates.
* Maintain runbooks, configuration records, and process documentation.
* Coordinate effectively with clients and internal teams across India and global time zones.



**Required technical skills** 



* Hands\-on experience administering
 **Qualys VMDR** 
 \& Configuration management or Qualys Vulnerability Management in an enterprise or managed\-services environment.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability scanning, authenticated scans, asset inventory, tagging, reporting, and remediation workflows.
* Ability to troubleshoot scan connectivity, credential failures, scanner performance, and incomplete asset coverage.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, Windows and Linux administration, and common enterprise infrastructure.
* Ability to interpret vulnerability findings, CVEs, severity ratings, and vendor remediation guidance.
* Experience producing actionable reports and tracking vulnerabilities through remediation and validation.



**Communication and client\-facing skills** 



* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to lead discussions with India\-based and global clients.
* Ability to explain technical risks and remediation steps clearly to stakeholders with different levels of technical expertise.
* Strong ownership of client queries, follow\-ups, escalations, and meeting notes.
* Comfortable coordinating across teams and time zones while maintaining a professional client experience.



**Preferred qualifications** 



* Experience with additional Qualys modules, such as Policy Compliance, Cloud Agent, Patch Management, or Cloud Security.
* Familiarity with ITSM or ticketing platforms and SIEM integrations.
* Experience supporting multiple client environments in an MSSP or consulting setting.
* Relevant Qualys certifications mandatory.

Position Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
 **Senior Infrastructure \& Specialist** 
 to join our India Equities Technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the high availability, reliability, and performance of our mission\-critical, high\-frequency trading (HFT) infrastructure and applications.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in capital markets, hands\-on expertise in Linux/Unix environments, deep knowledge of the FIX protocol, and a proven track record of supporting high\-touch trading desks, Direct Market Access (DMA), and algorithmic trading platforms. You will bridge the gap between infrastructure operations, development teams, and business stakeholders to maintain a seamless trading environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Infrastructure \& Environment Management
* Environment Maintenance: Manage and maintain multi\-tier UAT and Production environments, ensuring system stability, configuration consistency, and readiness for daily trading activities.
* Batch Scheduling \& Automation: Design, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot batch jobs using Autosys to automate critical operational workflows and data processing.
* System Operations: Perform daily Start of Day (SOD) and End of Day (EOD) activities on Linux systems to guarantee environment availability for live trading.
* Database Support: Query and manage relational databases (SQL, Postgres, Oracle) to fetch data, analyze table partitions, and support data warehousing requirements.
* Application \& Connectivity Support
* FIX Connectivity Management: Lead the functional enhancement, configuration, and monitoring of the FIX connectivity platform. Manage client onboarding, UAT testing, and certification of FIX algos.
* Trading Desk Support: Provide on\-floor L1/L2 production support to high\-touch trading desks for equities, futures, and options, as well as DMA and algorithmic trading desks.
* Exchange Connectivity: Coordinate and execute exchange connectivity tasks, including uploading exchange files, margin/position files, and participating in regular exchange mock trading sessions (e.g., NSE/BSE).
* Vendor \& Developer Collaboration: Act as the primary technical liaison with third\-party application vendors (e.g., Omnesys, Traderpath) and internal development teams to resolve complex application bugs and deploy backend fixes.
* Monitoring, Incident \& Change Management
* Proactive Monitoring: Utilize enterprise monitoring tools such as ITRS Geneos to track system health, latency, and connectivity, proactively addressing alerts before they impact the business.
* Incident Resolution: Own and manage production incidents from detection through to resolution. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and raise/track tickets in ServiceNow and Jira.
* Change \& Release Management: Schedule, coordinate, and deploy production changes, software packages, and drivers on servers during non\-market hours, adhering to strict change control policies.
* Regulatory Reporting: Ensure timely processing and transfer of operational and transaction files (e.g., OTR files) to regulatory bodies (e.g., SEBI) and clients.


**Required Technical Skills \& Qualifications**
 Experience \& Education
   

  

* Experience: Minimum of 7\+ years of experience in production support, application support, or infrastructure operations within the Capital Markets / Investment Banking domain.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electronics \& Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related technical field).


 Technical Competencies
   

  

* Operating Systems: Strong administration and troubleshooting skills in Linux/Unix and Windows environments.
* Scripting: Proficiency in Unix Shell Scripting for task automation, log analysis, and data extraction.
* Protocols: Deep understanding of FIX Protocols (session and application levels) and FIX configuration.
* Databases: Solid experience writing SQL queries and working with Postgres, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Tools \& Applications:
+ Scheduling: Autosys
+ Monitoring: ITRS Geneos
+ Ticketing/Collaboration: ServiceNow, Jira
+ Trading Applications: Experience with trading platforms (e.g., Omnesys, Traderpath, Gatelab HFT, Bloomberg) is highly desirable.


 Soft Skills \& Domain Knowledge
   

  
+ Domain Expertise: Comprehensive understanding of capital markets, equity/derivatives trading lifecycles, and high\-frequency trading (HFT) concepts.
+ Stakeholder Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, including Institutional Sales, Execution Traders, QA, Compliance, and external vendors.

description:
**Job Description**
**Internal Audit (IA)** 
 is an independent function at JPMorganChase that aims to enhance and protect the firm by providing risk\-based and objective assurance, advice, and insight. We work with every Line of Business and Corporate Function to assess the internal control processes that drive our global business, identifying areas of improvement to help safeguard the firm.
   

  

**IA Product Management** 
 is part of Audit, Strategy, Innovation and Practices (ASIP) and is a single, accountable organization that brings collective expertise together to own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of Internal Audit products and deliver consistent, high\-quality audit outcomes. In partnership with Audit Tech and stakeholders, it governs delivery, manages demand and change, and monitors product health (availability, performance, defects) to ensure reliable tools and a seamless user experience and also champions IA's data\-first strategy by improving data quality, enrichment, and usability to enable analytics, data\-driven audit decisions, and greater business impact.
   

  

 As a
 **Senior Customer Success Associate** 
 within
 **IA Product Management** 
 , you will develop and maintain strong relationships with internal customers (audit teams and stakeholders). You will also elevate the customer journey by translating product insights into trusted partnerships and enabling Internal Audit teams to realize value from ASIP products through proactive engagement, onboarding, and continuous improvement. You'll support adoption and retention of key audit products by running enablement, gathering feedback, tracking success metrics, and partnering with Product and Technology teams to improve user experience and outcomes. This role is based in Mumbai and requires strong stakeholder management, structured execution, and comfort operating in a matrixed organization.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end product support ticket intake, triage, and execution through closure: capture accurate topic/module details; resolve user\-education/standard requests where possible; route potential defects to product owners; ensure required tagging (team \+ category); and close the loop with users on outcomes and timelines.
* Monitor and improve service performance by tracking ticket volumes, aging (e.g., average days open), and resolution patterns; identify bottlenecks and drive operational improvements.
* Translate feedback into actionable prioritization inputs by consolidating feedback into clear problem statements, tracking requests through status, and supporting feature request governance and follow\-through.
* Support AI/ML lifecycle governance and model monitoring by coordinating required intake/approvals, maintaining documentation and control evidence, partnering with model owners on periodic performance/health reviews (e.g., drift, data quality, stability), and tracking remediation actions through to closure.
* Provide operational communications across incidents, service updates, and operational changes; tailor messaging to user groups and ensure consistent updates through resolution.
* Support access management operations across onboarding/offboarding: monitor provisioning/deprovisioning performance, handle exceptions, and ensure controls are executed consistently; perform BAU access activities to free leadership capacity for strategic work.
* Monitor business and technical data quality by reviewing exceptions based on thresholds (e.g., completeness, accuracy, timeliness), including Business Data Quality (BDQ) / Technical Data Quality (TDQ) monitoring as scope grows; analyze exceptions, follow up, and translate trends/root causes with Technology and data owners into prioritized remediation.
* End\-to\-end data management: establish governance policies, drive data quality (profiling, controls, issue/RCA, KPIs), manage metadata (glossary, lineage, catalog adoption), and enforce data lifecycle practices (classification, retention, archival, disposal).
* Support audit support tool monitoring in APAC to enable a follow\-the\-sun support model, including monitoring, exception triage/follow\-ups, and timely user support outside US hours.
* Coordinate across partners (Product, Technology, Controls, Audit Teams) to drive follow\-ups, manage escalations, and close the loop with customers.
* Support product\-led initiatives as needed by driving execution tracking, managing dependencies, and coordinating stakeholders through closure.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* 7\+ years of experience (or equivalent expertise) in customer success, business management, chief of staff, client services, product operations, program coordination, or stakeholder\-facing roles within product/technology environments.
* Demonstrated ability to influence adoption through enablement, relationship\-building, and structured follow\-through.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders across levels and functions.
* Proven ability to learn new technologies quickly and enable others through demos, documentation, and training.
* SQL proficiency \- write queries to inspect, analyze, and validate data across database tables.
* Data Profiling \- ability to perform data profiling, anomalies in the data and then root cause analysis on the Data Quality Issues.
* Define and execute the operating model for business glossary, metadata standards, lineage coverage, data quality controls, and governance.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver consistently in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Familiarity with risk, controls, audit, governance, or other regulated/controlled environments.
* Experience creating lightweight reporting and insights; summarizing themes into executive\-ready updates.
* Experience partnering with Product/Technology teams on incident triage, root\-cause themes, and continuous improvement follow\-ups.
* Deeper data modeling/architecture knowledge, hands\-on experience with data catalog/lineage/DQ/MDM tools, BI/analytics fluency, Agile/product delivery, and change\-management.
* Sound knowledge of Alteryx skilled in building automated workflows to clean, blend, and analyze complex data for rapid business insights.


**ABOUT US**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. title: OCI Administrator
description:
This role requires extensive experience in Oracle Cloud Security Administration, User Access Management, Environment Management, and Infrastructure Support across Oracle ERP Cloud, EPM Cloud, and AFCS applications. The individual will be responsible for managing user access security governance environment lifecycle activities and cloud platform administration to ensure secure, compliant, and efficient operation of enterprise applications.
 



  





  




* The candidate should possess strong expertise in Oracle Identity Cloud Service (IDCS), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) concepts, and application security administration.
* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) will be considered a significant advantage.
* Manage end\-to\-end user lifecycle activities including user creation, modification, deactivation, restoration, and access reviews across ERP, EPM, and AFCS environments.
* Configure and maintain User Roles, Role Hierarchies, Data Access Controls, and Security Policies across Oracle Cloud applications.
* Administer application security ensuring compliance with organizational governance and segregation of duties (SoD) requirements.
* Perform periodic user access certification, role audits, and security reviews.
* Troubleshoot and resolve user access authentication, authorization, and security\-related issues.



  





  





**Oracle Identity Cloud Service (IDCS) Administration:** 



* Administer Oracle IDCS for user authentication, authorization, identity federation, and Single Sign\-On (SSO) management.
* Manage user provisioning, group management, application assignments, and identity synchronization.
* Configure and support Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), password policies, security policies, and access controls.
* Integrate enterprise directories such as Active Directory and other identity providers with Oracle Cloud applications.
* Support user onboarding, offboarding, and identity governance processes.
* Monitor identity\-related security incidents and support audit and compliance activities.



  





  





**Environment and Instance Management:** 



* Plan, coordinate, and execute environment cloning activities across Development, Test, UAT, Pre\-Production, and Production environments.
* Manage post\-clone activities including security refresh, integration validation, scheduling adjustments, and configuration verification.
* Perform user restoration, access synchronization, and environment\-specific security configurations following cloning activities.
* Coordinate application patching, maintenance windows, release management, and environment refresh activities.

title: Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About Alkem:**




  





 Alkem Laboratories Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai, that manufactures and sells pharmaceutical generics, formulations and nutraceuticals in India and globally over 50 countries. We have consistently been ranked amongst the top five pharmaceutical companies in India. Our portfolio includes illustrious brands like Clavam, Pan, Pan\-D, and Taxim\-O, which feature amongst the top 50 pharmaceutical brands in India.
 



  





**Purpose of the Role:**




  





 To own the architecture, engineering, operations, security, availability, identity services, automation, resilience, and cost governance of Alkem’s hybrid infrastructure landscape, including Azure, AWS, Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, virtualization platforms, data centres, storage, backup, and disaster recovery environments.
 



 The role is responsible for delivering secure, scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective infrastructure and identity services across Alkem’s corporate offices, manufacturing locations, R\&D centres, data centres, and international operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  





 Hybrid Cloud Architecture \& Engineering
 


* Design, implement, and maintain reference architectures, standards, patterns, and governance frameworks for Azure, AWS, private cloud, and on\-premise infrastructure environments.
* Evaluate workload placement strategies based on business requirements, performance, security, compliance, recoverability, integration, data residency, and total cost of ownership.
* Conduct architecture reviews for new applications, cloud migrations, infrastructure upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
* Maintain architecture documentation, infrastructure standards, build specifications, configuration baselines, technical diagrams, and operational runbooks.



 Cloud Platform Operations \& Governance
 


* Manage cloud subscriptions, accounts, landing zones, management groups, resource hierarchies, tagging structures, policies, quotas, and shared services.
* Implement and govern controls for identity integration, privileged access, key and secret management, cloud connectivity, monitoring, logging, vulnerability remediation, backup, and patch management.
* Monitor cloud service health, capacity, availability, utilization, and performance metrics.
* Drive cloud governance, operational excellence, and FinOps initiatives to optimize infrastructure costs.



 Identity \& Access Infrastructure Management
 


* Administer and support Microsoft Active Directory, Hybrid Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and enterprise identity management platforms.
* Manage domain controllers, Active Directory forests, trusts, replication, DNS integration, Sites and Services, and Group Policy administration.
* Maintain hybrid identity services including Microsoft Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, federation services, and directory synchronization.
* Govern Single Sign\-On (SSO), Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), passwordless authentication, and Conditional Access policies.
* Manage identity lifecycle processes including user provisioning, deprovisioning, RBAC, service accounts, delegated administration, and privileged access controls.
* Support Privileged Identity Management (PIM), identity governance, access reviews, tiered administration, and privileged account protection.
* Ensure identity platform resilience through backup, disaster recovery, platform hardening, recovery testing, and replication monitoring.
* Support application integrations using LDAP, Kerberos, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and modern authentication protocols.
* Integrate identity logs, audit trails, authentication events, and threat intelligence with enterprise SIEM and SOC platforms.
* Drive identity modernization and Zero Trust initiatives in collaboration with Cybersecurity, HR, application, and business stakeholders.



 On\-Premise Infrastructure, Virtualization \& Storage
 


* Manage physical and virtual server infrastructure, operating systems, hypervisors, clusters, storage systems, converged infrastructure, and management platforms.
* Oversee provisioning, hardening, patching, performance tuning, capacity management, lifecycle refresh, decommissioning, and compliance management.
* Support business\-critical infrastructure for SAP, manufacturing systems, databases, middleware, analytics platforms, and enterprise applications.



 Automation, Observability \& Resilience
 


* Drive automation initiatives using scripting, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management tools, orchestration platforms, and reusable templates.
* Implement automated governance, compliance checks, and operational workflows.
* Establish centralized monitoring, observability, log management, dashboarding, event correlation, alerting, and service health reporting.
* Own enterprise backup, replication, recovery infrastructure, immutable repositories, cyber recovery, and disaster recovery readiness.
* Conduct restoration testing, disaster recovery drills, and business continuity exercises aligned with defined recovery objectives.



 Security \& Service Management
 


* Implement secure infrastructure baselines, encryption standards, privileged access controls, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, and Zero Trust security practices.
* Ensure infrastructure and identity telemetry is integrated with enterprise monitoring and security operations platforms.
* Own ITSM processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Configuration, Capacity, and Availability Management.
* Lead major incident management, root cause analysis, preventive action planning, knowledge management, and runbook development.
* Manage infrastructure service providers and vendors against contractual obligations, SLAs, security requirements, and performance metrics.



  





**Educational Qualifications:**




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics \& Telecommunications, or a related discipline.
* Relevant cloud, infrastructure, or identity certifications will be an added advantage.



  





**Experience:**




  




* 6 to 8 years of progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure management.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in cloud, hybrid infrastructure, or identity platform architecture and operations.
* Experience in managing Azure and/or AWS cloud environments, Active Directory, Hybrid AD, Microsoft Entra ID, virtualization, storage, backup, and disaster recovery platforms.
* Experience supporting highly available enterprise applications and geographically distributed operations.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, chemical, manufacturing, or other regulated industries will be preferred.



  





**Technical Skills:**




  





 Strong expertise in Azure Cloud Services and AWS Cloud Services, with deep knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, Hybrid Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). Proficient in managing Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Group Policy Administration, Conditional Access, Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), Single Sign\-On (SSO), Passwordless Authentication, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Identity Governance \& Access Management. Hands\-on experience with Windows and Linux Server Administration, Virtualization Platforms, Storage Management, Backup and Disaster Recovery Solutions, and enterprise infrastructure operations. Strong capabilities in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Scripting and Automation, FinOps and Cloud Cost Optimization, and Observability \& Monitoring Tools. Sound understanding of identity and authentication protocols including LDAP, Kerberos, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SCIM, along with practical knowledge of ITIL Service Management Practices for delivering reliable, secure, and scalable IT services.

description:
Reporting: Property Manager

 satisfaction. The role involves managing helpdesk operations, coordinating with technical and soft services teams, maintaining accurate records, and facilitating
   

  

 amenity bookings to enhance resident experience in a residential complex.

* Query Logging: Record resident requests and complaints received via phone, email, or in\- person in the helpdesk system, ensuring 100% accuracy.

* Root Cause Analysis: Document the root cause for each request and update the system to support pattern analysis and corrective actions.
* Emergency Escalation: Notify the facility manager or site team promptly for emergency situations, ensuring rapid response.
* Resident Follow\-Up: Follow up with residents to confirm satisfactory closure of requests, addressing any outstanding concerns.

* Resident Information: Maintain an updated database of client contact details, emergency contacts, and stakeholder information in the helpdesk module.

* SOP Adherence: Ensure compliance with company policies, client guidelines, and standard cooperating procedures (SOPs) in all operations.
* Duty Roster: Prepare and coordinate duty rosters with the site team to ensure seamless operations.
* Attendance and SLA Support: Assist in month\- end closing of staff attendance and vendor Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance reports.
* Amenity Booking Management
* Booking Coordination: Manage bookings for amenities (e.g., clubhouse, gym, banquet hall), ensuring accurate scheduling and resident communication.
* Payment Tracking: Monitor and record payments for amenity bookings, issuing receipts and maintaining financial logs.
* Booking Updates: Provide residents with timely confirmations and updates on availability, addressing conflicts promptly.
* Communication and Circulars
* Resident Communication: Send circulars, emails, and notices to residents using approved templates, ensuring clarity and professionalism.
* Query Response: Respond to resident inquiries consistently within defined TAT, maintaining a courteous and solution\-oriented approach.
* Internal Coordination: Liaise with technical, soft services, and management teams to relay critical updates and ensure alignment.
* Vendor and Service Coordination
* Service Follow\-Up: Monitor scheduled cleaning, technical, and maintenance services as per monthly plans, ensuring adherence to standards.
* Vendor Bill Tracking: Maintain a tracker for vendor bills, verifying accuracy and coordinating with the site manager for approvals.
* Equipment Complaints: Log complaints for equipment breakdowns with service providers, tracking resolution timelines.
* MIS and Reporting
* Report Generation: Prepare and circulate daily, weekly, fortnightly, and monthly Management Information System (MIS) reports on complaints, requests, and amenity usage.
* Complaint Analysis: Analyze complaint logs versus TAT monthly to identify patterns and recommend corrective actions.
* Ad Hoc Reporting: Generate ad hoc reports as required by management, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
* Record Maintenance: Keep organized records of all helpdesk activities, including vendor bills, attendance, and resident interactions.
* Customer Service Excellence
* Resident Engagement: Foster positive relationships with residents through proactive communication and empathetic handling of concerns.
* Issue Resolution: Escalate unresolved complaints to the Property Manager or relevant authority for swift closure.
* Feedback Collection: Gather resident feedback on helpdesk services and share insights with management to improve processes.
* System and Process Optimization
* Software Utilization: Ensure efficient use of helpdesk software for logging, tracking, and reporting activities, maintaining data integrity.
* Staff Management: Manage staff additions and exits in systems for attendance and operational purposes, ensuring seamless transitions.
* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline helpdesk workflows, reducing TAT and enhancing resident satisfaction.]

description:

 Job Description \- Technical Support Engineer (Linux / Windows / GitLab / Networking)
   

  

 Job Title
   

  

 Technical Support Engineer
   

  

**Experience**
 1\-3 Years
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a proactive and technically skilled Technical Support Engineer with 2\-3 years of experience in Linux, Windows Server administration, GitLab, and networking. The ideal candidate should possess strong troubleshooting skills and be capable of supporting server infrastructure, network devices, and DevOps tools while ensuring high system availability.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Provide L2 technical support for Linux and Windows servers.
   

  

 Install, configure, and troubleshoot Linux (Ubuntu/RHEL/CentOS) and Windows Server environments.
   

  

 Monitor server health, system performance, and resource utilization.
   

  

 Troubleshoot application, OS, and infrastructure\-related issues.
   

  

 Manage user accounts, permissions, and system services.
   

  

 Support GitLab administration, repository management, user access, branching, and merge requests.
   

  

 Assist development teams with Git workflows and CI/CD pipeline troubleshooting.
   

  

 Configure and troubleshoot networking issues including routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and load balancing.
   

  

 Support firewall administration, including policy creation, NAT, ACLs, and security rule implementation.
   

  

 Diagnose connectivity issues using tools such as ping, traceroute, tcpdump, netstat, and Wireshark.
   

  

 Coordinate with application, database, network, and security teams for incident resolution.
   

  

 Perform system patching, upgrades, and preventive maintenance.
   

  

 Maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and incident reports.
   

  

 Participate in on\-call support and production issue handling when required.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 Operating Systems
   

  

 Linux (Ubuntu, RHEL, CentOS)
   

  

 Windows Server Administration
   

  

 Version Control
   

  

 Git
   

  

 GitLab Administration
   

  

 Repository Management
   

  

 Branching \& Merging
   

  

 GitLab CI/CD (basic knowledge)
   

  

 Networking
   

  

 TCP/IP
   

  

 Routing \& Switching
   

  

 VLANs
   

  

 DNS
   

  

 DHCP
   

  

 NAT
   

  

 VPN
   

  

 Load Balancing
   

  

 Firewall Administration
   

  

 Troubleshooting Tools
   

  

 SSH
   

  

 PuTTY
   

  

 WinSCP
   

  

 tcpdump
   

  

 netstat
   

  

 traceroute
   

  

 ping
   

  

 Wireshark
   

  

**Scripting (Preferred)**
 Bash Shell Scripting
   

  

 PowerShell (basic)
   

  

**Monitoring (Preferred)**
 Zabbix
   

  

 Grafana
   

  

 Prometheus
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
   

  

 Knowledge of virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper\-V, or OpenStack is an advantage.
   

  

 Basic understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is desirable.
   

  

 Experience with HAProxy, Nginx, Apache, or Keepalived is a plus.
   

  

 Soft Skills
   

  

 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
   

  

 Excellent communication skills.
   

  

 Ability to work independently and within a team.
   

  

 Good documentation skills.
   

  

 Ability to handle multiple incidents in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Willingness to learn new technologies.

 RHCSA
   

  

 Microsoft Certified: Windows Server
   

  

 CCNA
   

  

 LPIC
